meta.name: paid-ads-review
meta.description: Produce a read-only, evidence-based paid-media performance review across connected platforms or supplied exports. Use for weekly or monthly reports, scorecards, performance, CPA, ROAS, CTR, spend trends, pacing, or conversion-tracking health.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 生成跨平台广告投放绩效报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你需要定期查看付费广告表现
copy.tagline_en: Generate cross-platform paid ads performance reports
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need regular paid media performance reviews

howto.what: 安装后,Claude 会生成一份只读的付费媒体效果回顾:先核对数据源与转化跟踪,再输出平台记分卡(花费、转化、CPA、ROAS、CTR 等),与上一周期对比,并给出最大风险和建议行动。它只做分析,不做任何广告改动。
howto.when: 当用户要求生成每周或每月效果报告,或询问 CPA/ROAS 表现,或关注花费趋势时触发。

say.text: 帮我做本周付费广告效果回顾,只读,不修改任何设置。
say.note: 生成只读周报,不动广告配置。

say.text: 对比上周,分析 CPA 和 ROAS 变化,指出最大风险。
检查转化跟踪是否健康,并出一个平台记分卡。
say.note: 输出记分卡和跟踪状态。

howto.what_en: Produces a read-only paid-media review: verifies sources and tracking, builds a platform scorecard (spend, conversions, CPA, ROAS, CTR), compares with prior period, and ends with top risk and one action. No ad changes.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks for a weekly/monthly paid-ads review, asks about CPA/ROAS performance, or mentions spend trends.

say_en.text: Help me do a read-only review of this week's paid ads.
Compare with last week, analyze CPA and ROAS changes, point out the biggest risk.
Check conversion tracking health and produce a platform scorecard.
